title: Lake Pleasant Ignite Series Paddleboard Night Tour Near Phoenix
includes: Paddleboard, paddle, illuminated light system, and US Coast Guard-approved life jacket
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Experience Lake Pleasant from sunset into the night on a guided 1.5-hour Ignite Series paddleboard tour. After a safety briefing and basic paddling instruction, launch from the shoreline as the Arizona sky changes color. As darkness falls, the paddleboard’s illuminated light system creates a colorful glow on the water. Your guide leads the group throughout the experience, making this a memorable adventure for both first-time and experienced paddlers. Paddleboard, paddle, US Coast Guard-approved life jacket, and lighting equipment are included. Participants must be able to swim and follow all guide and park safety instructions.
